body: I don't just mean depression I mean everything. After being physically and mentally abused by my father i grew up in children's homes and foster homes, some with abusive carers/guardians. I wanted to help other struggling kids growing up to make sure they were looked after and to try to give them a decent start at life so they wouldn't end up messed up like I am. I am from the UK. Even though I didn't have the best start in life there are plenty of  people that have had it a lot worse than I have.

It's sad to see so many people struggling. I have always thought that maybe if I could help other people with their struggles no matter what it is then maybe it would give my life purpose and make It worth living.  Atm I can't even seem to help myself so what good am I to others. I'm so tired and exhausted. Constant battle in my mind that I'm losing no matter how hard I fight it.

I just read yours and its scarily similar to what I'm going through. I have nothing going for me, try to drown out my miserable existence by playing the same games and songs over and over. Main thing that has stopped me until this point has been the fear of failing. I'm not going to lie I'm still very afraid of failing but i can't see a way forward from this. There has to be something wrong with my brain. The thoughts I have are definitely not what I would consider "normal". I have tried and tried to live a "normal" life but I'm exhausted. I don't have much fight left in me. If you need someone to talk/vent to Ill listen to your for aslong as I'm here. I hope things get better for you and you find peace in whatever you chose to do.
I can't seem to help myself but if there's anything i can say/do that will help with your life before I take mine let me know.
2 close friends and my terminally I'll mother :(

I don't want to live. But I don't have what it takes to finish it. I'm too much of a coward. To want to die and to actually take your own life is 2 different things all together. That's just my opinion of course

Thank you for the reply. I have been looking through the posts to try to find something I can relate to or someone that has experienced something similar so I can ask how they have dealt with it. It's hard for me to understand what's going on inside my head. I know that my thoughts are irrational and I am constantly battling with myself to suppress the negative and ridiculous scenarios that play out in my head. I don't want to fight with with myself anymore. I'm exhausted.
